Appendix (Rules for the Implementation of the Duties and Functions of the Marine Police Agency and its Affiliated Institutions) <No. 250, July 26, 2017>

Article 1 (Effective Date) This rule shall take effect from the date of its promulgation. However, any revisions to the supplementary regulations as specified in Article 4 of this rule, which were promulgated prior to the effective date of this rule but have not yet taken effect, shall take effect from the effective date of the corresponding supplementary regulation or decree.

Articles 2 and 3 omitted

Article 4 (Revision of Other Regulations) Items ① to ⑧ omitted

⑨ The following portions of the "Rules for the Implementation of the Maritime Guard Act" are revised:

Item 1 of Article 2, excluding the phrases "police officers belonging to the Ministry of Public Safety," is replaced with "police officers belonging to the Marine Police Agency (hereinafter referred to as "Marine Police Officers")."

Items 1 of Article 2 and the same article, Item 2, are replaced with "Marine Police Officers."

Item 5 of Article 3, Item 2, replaces "Minister of Public Safety" with "Chief of the Marine Police Agency."

"Chief of the Maritime Safety Command" shall be referred to as "Chief of the Marine Police Agency, Chief of the Local Marine Police Agency, or Chief of the Marine Police Station in the relevant jurisdiction."
